sources.name: ur7e_stack
sources.real_robot_evidence: Source card states these are real UR7e forward demonstrations.
sources.state_semantics: Six measured UR7e joint positions followed by the source gripper ratio.
sources.action_semantics: Six absolute UR7e target joint positions followed by the source gripper target; not delta action.
sources.gripper_semantics: Robotiq 2F-85 style ratio in source range [0,1]; open/closed orientation is not explicitly stated by the card and must not be inferred or changed.
sources.notes: One data shard and two camera shards contain all 100 episodes, so the two-episode pilot cannot avoid downloading those packed files.

sources.name: droid_success
sources.real_robot_evidence: Source card identifies successful DROID-COMMUNITY episodes; DROID is an in-the-wild real Franka dataset.
sources.state_semantics: Seven measured Franka joint positions plus the separately stored measured gripper position.
sources.action_semantics: Seven commanded Franka joint positions plus the separately stored commanded absolute gripper position.
sources.gripper_semantics: DROID absolute command in [0,1], with 0 fully open and 1 fully closed. Values remain source-native.
sources.notes: Native rate is 15 Hz, so the complete configured 8D vector is linearly interpolated to 30 Hz.

sources.name: droid_failure
sources.real_robot_evidence: Source card identifies failure episodes from the real-robot DROID-COMMUNITY collection.
sources.state_semantics: Seven measured Franka joint positions plus the separately stored measured gripper position.
sources.action_semantics: Seven commanded Franka joint positions plus the separately stored commanded absolute gripper position.
sources.gripper_semantics: DROID absolute command in [0,1], with 0 fully open and 1 fully closed. Values remain source-native.
sources.notes: The failure conversion has no task/language fields, so final diversity and failure-mode selection requires full-episode proxy review.

sources.name: robochallenge_raw
sources.usage_basis: Public repository access under the Hugging Face Terms of Service; confirm institutional requirements before redistribution.
sources.real_robot_evidence: Table30 v2 is described as demonstrations collected on real ARX5, UR5, ALOHA, and DOS-W1 robots.
sources.state_semantics: Six measured joint angles in radians followed by measured gripper width in meters.
sources.action_semantics: RoboChallenge exception: an exact copy of the same-timestamp measured joint positions and gripper width; not a native commanded action.
sources.gripper_semantics: Measured gripper width in meters copied unchanged into both state and action; no inversion or normalization.
sources.notes: Explicit source-specific exception approved: copy the measured joint-position plus gripper vector into action. Native actions remain mandatory and preserved for every other source.
